skill.name: test-ops
skill.description: Standardizes test planning, implementation, execution, and reporting for software quality work.
skill.summary: Guides structured test operations from design through coverage review.
skill.author: A-Genno

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a high-entropy heuristic on SKILL.md. Manual review shows readable Japanese Markdown with testing guidance, so the finding is a false positive.

static_findings.pattern: [HEURISTIC] High file entropy (6.69 bits) - possible binary/encrypted content

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md is plain Japanese Markdown with front matter and test process guidance. No binary, encrypted, or obfuscated content was found.

content.value_statement: Testing work often becomes inconsistent across planning, execution, and reporting. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code guide structured test operations.
actual_capabilities: Outlines test design for normal, error, boundary, and edge cases.
Recommends independent tests that can run without cross-test dependencies.
Defines mocking guidance for databases, APIs, time-dependent code, and file I/O.
Provides implementation steps from feature analysis through coverage review.
Specifies test quality standards for structure, names, assertions, and error messages.
limitations: Does not include runnable test scripts or framework-specific commands.
Does not inspect project code without user-provided context.
Coverage goals still require engineering judgment.
Provides general testing guidance, not a complete QA governance process.

use_cases.title: Plan Feature Test Coverage
use_cases.description: Create a clear test plan that covers normal, error, boundary, and edge cases.

use_cases.title: Review Mocking Strategy
use_cases.description: Decide how to isolate databases, APIs, clocks, timers, and file access during tests.

use_cases.title: Standardize Test Reports
use_cases.description: Align test implementation and results reporting around consistent quality criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Test Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new feature
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test-ops skill to create a test plan for this feature. Include normal, error, boundary, and edge cases.

prompt_templates.title: Design Isolated Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test-ops skill to design independent tests for this component. Identify needed mocks and fixtures.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Test Quality
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test-ops skill to review these tests for independence, readability, assertions, and failure messages.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Coverage Improvement Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the test-ops skill to find coverage gaps and propose a prioritized plan to improve test completeness.

output_examples.input: Plan tests for a payment retry feature.
output_examples.output: A structured plan covering successful retries, declined payments, timeout handling, retry limits, duplicate prevention, and reporting expectations.

output_examples.input: Review how to mock external services in tests.
output_examples.output: Guidance to mock HTTP clients, use stable response patterns, isolate database access, and fix time-dependent behavior.

output_examples.input: Improve the quality of an existing test suite.
output_examples.output: A review checklist for AAA structure, readable names, clear assertions, independent execution, and useful failure messages.

best_practices: Provide the feature behavior, expected risks, and current test framework before asking for a plan.
Ask for separate normal, error, boundary, and edge cases to avoid missing important scenarios.
Review proposed mocks against real system boundaries before implementing tests.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for full coverage without explaining the feature or business risk.
Do not treat generated test plans as a substitute for running the actual test suite.
Do not mock behavior that should be verified through integration tests.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps structure test planning, implementation, execution checks, and reporting standards.

faq.question: Does it generate runnable test code?
faq.answer: It provides testing strategy and implementation guidance. Runnable code depends on the project and framework context.

faq.question: Can it help with mocks?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives guidance for databases, external APIs, clocks, timers, and file system access.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is this skill specific to one programming language?
faq.answer: No. The guidance is general and can be adapted to different test frameworks.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide feature requirements, known risks, existing tests, target framework, and coverage goals.
